mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts level below 800,000 units consistently predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to weak consumer sector activity and reduced economic growth expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 800, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy, which compresses risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
